Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_LargeShinin.en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA large, shining bird is flying\ntoward the sea.
Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_LargeShinin.fr: Voyons ce que les jumelles\nmontrent…\pUn grand oiseau brillant vole vers\nla mer.

Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_SmallIsland.en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt looks like a small island on\nthe horizon!
Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_SmallIsland.fr: Voyons ce que les jumelles\nmontrent…\pOn dirait une petite île à\nl'horizon !
